html:
This week ED visits related to COVID (SARS-CoV-2), influenza and respiratory sysncytial virus (RSV) continue to be low, under 1% of overall visits.

COVID virus levels are currently elevated in sampled wastewater in Lawrence. Influenza A virus levels are higher than they have been in recent weeks while Influenza B continues to be low. Levels of RSV are also low.

The best way to prevent respiratory illness is by getting vaccinated. Visit ldchealth.org/vaccine-selfschedule for upcoming flu and COVID walk-in clinics, or call 785-843-0721 to schedule your appointment.

Everyone can take action to reduce the spread of respiratory viruses!
  • Practice good hygiene by covering your coughs and sneezes.
  • Wash your hands often.
  • Clean frequently touched surfaces.
  • Stay home when you're sick.
